title: CLAUDE.md
text: nhsbsa low-level R client NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA) Open Data Portal — standard CKAN catalogue https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/. generic client domain knowledge: functions wrap CKAN API actions one--one return plain data (tibbles tabular results, lists metadata). Callers supply dataset identifiers interpret results; domain-specific logic belongs separate consumer package, .

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Purity. One exported function per CKAN action, named , argument every documented API parameter, users familiar API need relearn anything. deliberate exceptions two convenience helpers nhsbsa_list_resources() nhsbsa_download_resource(). One request layer. Every endpoint thin caller nhsbsa_query() (R/core.R), reads calling function’s arguments query string, performs request retry/backoff, validates CKAN envelope fails gracefully portal unreachable. Portal quirks (documented relevant): datastore identifies resource name (e.g. EPD_201401), UUID; datastore_search_sql requires resource_id alongside sql nests records one level deeper standard CKAN.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: UK English throughout (e.g. “serialise”, “behaviour”, “parameterise”). snake_case; exported functions prefixed nhsbsa_. Use cli via internal wrappers nhsbsa_abort() / nhsbsa_warn() / nhsbsa_inform() (R/conditions.R) — never another package’s error helpers. Give conditions specific subclasses can handled programmatically. HTTP via httr2. Prefer tidyverse (dplyr, purrr, stringr, tibble) reads well; use base R genuinely simpler.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Tests use testthat (edition 3). Network tests replay recorded httptest2 fixtures run offline; live API tests gated behind NHSBSA_LIVE_TESTS. devtools::test() — run tests (set NHSBSA_LIVE_TESTS=true include live). lintr::lint_package() — lint. air format . — format. devtools::document() — regenerate docs. devtools::check() — R CMD check. spelling::spell_check_package() — UK English spell check. recording new fixtures, keep with_mock_dir() directory names short: fixed opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/ path deep, long names can push tarball paths portable 100-byte limit.

title: Developer guide
text: nhsbsa low-level, general-purpose client NHS Business Services Authority Open Data Portal, CKAN catalogue. Two principles shape every decision: Purity. one exported function per CKAN action, named , argument every documented API parameter. user knows CKAN API learn anything new. deliberate exceptions two convenience helpers nhsbsa_list_resources() nhsbsa_download_resource(). “exceptions” , unlike every exported function, neither corresponds single CKAN action: nhsbsa_list_resources() calls nhsbsa_package_show() reshapes nested resources list tibble, nhsbsa_download_resource() resolves resource (via nhsbsa_package_show()) streams file url — ordinary HTTP download part /action/ API . earn place together operations caller often needs. domain knowledge. package knows nothing specific datasets (BNF, prescribing, dental, ). returns plain data — tibbles tabular results, lists metadata — leaves interpretation caller. Dataset-specific logic belongs separate package depends one.

title: Developer guide
text: package thin shell around single request layer.
code: endpoint functions  ->  nhsbsa_query()  ->  httr2  ->  CKAN    (R/package.R,         (R/core.R)     resources.R,     datastore.R,     catalogue.R)

title: Developer guide
text: nhsbsa_query(action) work: inspects calling endpoint function rlang::caller_fn() rlang::fn_fmls_names(), reads argument values caller’s environment, turns query parameters. Arguments prefixed . (.return_raw) reserved client behaviour never sent API. Values coerced CKAN nhsbsa_format_query_value(): NULLs dropped, logicals become "true"/"false", multi-element vectors joined commas, lists (filters) encoded JSON. request performed retry/backoff. nhsbsa_perform() translates transport failures graceful nhsbsa_offline error HTTP errors nhsbsa_api_error (plus status-specific subclass nhsbsa_http_404). CKAN envelope validated: success = FALSE raises nhsbsa_api_error; otherwise returns result element (, caller passed .return_raw = TRUE, whole parsed envelope). parameters read function signature, endpoint wrapper usually single line — see .

title: Developer guide
text: messages, warnings errors go nhsbsa_abort(), nhsbsa_warn() nhsbsa_inform(). wrap corresponding cli functions, always append base class (nhsbsa_error / nhsbsa_warning / nhsbsa_message), accept optional class prepend specific subclass. Give condition specific subclass whenever caller might reasonably want catch , e.g. call cli::cli_abort() (package’s error helpers) directly.
code: nhsbsa_abort(   c("x" = "No resource matched."),   class = "nhsbsa_resource_not_found" )

title: Developer guide
text: Catalogue/metadata actions return list (package_show, package_search, resource_show). Listing actions return character vector (package_list, organization_list, group_list, tag_list). Row queries return tibble (datastore_search, datastore_search_sql, list_resources). nhsbsa_download_resource() returns destination path invisibly. read-function called .return_raw = TRUE returns parsed envelope list.

title: Developer guide
text: portal exposes standard CKAN read API (can confirm given instance supports help_show, e.g. https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/help_show?name=package_search). package wraps useful read subset actions — dataset discovery, resource listing/metadata/download, datastore queries, catalogue listings. registered actions (*_autocomplete family, datastore_info, license_list, status_show, ) intentionally wrapped yet. gap discovered, convention open issue add wrapper .

title: Developer guide
text: wrap another CKAN action, add thin function whose arguments mirror API parameters. example, wrap tag_show: whole implementation: nhsbsa_query() picks id signature sends query parameter. action returns tabular data, post-process result nhsbsa_records_to_tibble(). : Keep examples gated @examplesIf identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true") render documentation site never run CRAN.
code: #' Show a tag #' #' Wraps the CKAN `tag_show` action. #' #' @param id Character scalar. The tag name or id. #' @inheritParams nhsbsa_package_list #' #' @return A list of tag metadata. #' @export #' @examplesIf identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true") #' nhsbsa_tag_show("prescribing") nhsbsa_tag_show <- function(id, .return_raw = FALSE) {   nhsbsa_query("tag_show") } devtools::document() # regenerate NAMESPACE and the .Rd file

Wrap block with_mock_dir(); first run records responses, later runs replay : Keep mock directory name short. portal’s URL path (opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/) deep, R CMD check rejects tarball paths longer 100 bytes, long directory name plus long action name can tip fixture limit.

title: Developer guide
text: error paths edge cases simpler mock HTTP response directly, without fixture, using httr2::with_mocked_responses():
code: test_that("an HTTP error surfaces as nhsbsa_api_error", {   resp <- httr2::response(     status_code = 404L,     headers = list(`Content-Type` = "application/json"),     body = charToRaw('{"success":false,"error":{"message":"nope"}}')   )   httr2::with_mocked_responses(function(req) resp, {     expect_error(nhsbsa_package_show("x"), class = "nhsbsa_http_404")   }) })

title: Getting started with nhsbsa
text: NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA) Open Data Portal publishes open datasets NHS activity England — prescribing, dental, pharmaceutical contractor data among . freely available Open Government Licence. portal runs CKAN, widely used open-source data catalogue. CKAN organises data datasets (called “packages”) contain one resources — individual files (usually CSV) can download, , tabular resources, query row row. nhsbsa thin, low-level client portal. wraps CKAN API returns plain data work : tibbles tabular results lists metadata. contains knowledge particular dataset, supply dataset identifiers interpret results . familiar CKAN API, package feel familiar : function names arguments mirror API.

what: The API and the response envelope
title: Getting started with nhsbsa
text: Every request goes CKAN action comes back JSON envelope form , failure, nhsbsa handles envelope : checks success flag, returns result, otherwise raises informative error. portal reached (example internet connection) fails gracefully clear message rather obscure low-level error. full set actions documented CKAN Action API reference, portal return documentation individual action supports, e.g. https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/help_show?name=datastore_search_sql.
code: https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/<action> { "success": true, "result": ... } { "success": false, "error": { "message": "..." } }

title: Getting started with nhsbsa
text: package wraps useful read subset portal’s actions, four small groups (package reference index organised way). need action yet wrapped, please open issue. Datasets — discover inspect datasets (“packages”): nhsbsa_package_list() (every dataset id), nhsbsa_package_search() (search), nhsbsa_package_show() (one dataset’s metadata, including resources). Resources — work files dataset: nhsbsa_resource_show() (one resource’s metadata), plus two convenience helpers, nhsbsa_list_resources() nhsbsa_download_resource(). Datastore — query rows tabular resource without downloading : nhsbsa_datastore_search() nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql(). Catalogue — list portal’s taxonomy: nhsbsa_organization_list(), nhsbsa_group_list() nhsbsa_tag_list(). Almost every function maps one--one onto CKAN action name. two exceptions resource helpers, combine action little extra work pure wrappers: nhsbsa_list_resources() calls nhsbsa_package_show() reshapes nested resources tibble — one row per file, including file’s download url. nhsbsa_download_resource() resolves single resource (via nhsbsa_package_show()) streams resource’s file url disk. download ordinary HTTP request, CKAN action. (nhsbsa_group_list() included completeness; portal currently defines groups returns empty vector — organises data organisation tags instead.) read-functions also accept .return_raw = TRUE, returns full parsed response envelope instead processed result — useful need fields helper surface, datastore query’s total.

title: Getting started with nhsbsa
text: nhsbsa_datastore_search() returns rows resource. can choose order columns fields, sort sort, page limit/offset. Field names case-sensitive must match resource’s columns exactly (EPD upper case, e.g. PCO_CODE): datastore returns one page rows per request. rows exist returned, nhsbsa_datastore_search() warns explains page rest increasing offset: CKAN’s datastore_search also defines filters (exact field matching) q (full-text search) parameters, nhsbsa_datastore_search() exposes completeness. aware portal’s datastore apply — return matching rows — filter value, use SQL instead.

title: Getting started with nhsbsa
text: nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql() runs read-SQL query, reliable way filter, compute expressions, aggregate sort portal. portal requires resource_id alongside query, reference resource name clause: SQL string sent API verbatim, responsible paging (via LIMIT/OFFSET) quoting identifiers correctly.
code: # Filter to one organisation nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql(   resource_id = "EPD_202401",   sql = "SELECT PCO_CODE, BNF_CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE, ITEMS          FROM `EPD_202401`          WHERE PCO_CODE = 'W2U3Z'          LIMIT 5" ) #> # A tibble: 5 × 3 #>   PCO_CODE BNF_CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE ITEMS #>   <chr>    <chr>                  <int> #> 1 W2U3Z    1302011L0                  1 #> 2 W2U3Z    0403040W0                  4 #> 3 W2U3Z    0401010AD                  1 #> 4 W2U3Z    0205040D0                  4 #> 5 W2U3Z    2130                       4 # Aggregate: total items prescribed per organisation nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql(   resource_id = "EPD_202401",   sql = "SELECT PCO_CODE, SUM(ITEMS) AS items          FROM `EPD_202401`          GROUP BY PCO_CODE          ORDER BY items DESC          LIMIT 5" ) #> # A tibble: 5 × 2 #>   PCO_CODE   items #>   <chr>      <int> #> 1 91Q00    3151968 #> 2 W2U3Z    3129964 #> 3 A3A8R    3124609 #> 4 D9Y0V    2697474 #> 5 15N00    2413359

title: Search a resource's rows — nhsbsa_datastore_search
text: resource_id Character scalar. resource query. NHSBSA datastore identifies resource name (name column nhsbsa_list_resources()), e.g. "EPD_201401", rather id. q full-text query (character scalar, named list per-field search). Accepted API completeness applied portal; use nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql() instead. distinct Logical. Return rows distinct across selected fields? plain Logical. Controls q full-text query parsed (TRUE, default, treats q plain text). relevant q, portal apply. language Character scalar. text-search language (e.g. "english"). limit Integer. Maximum number rows return request. offset Integer. Number rows skip, paging. fields Character vector. fields return, order. sort Character scalar vector. Sort clause(s), e.g. "ITEMS desc". filters Named list. Field-value pairs filter . Accepted API completeness applied portal; use nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql() instead. include_total Logical. Include total match count response? Required incomplete-results warning; defaults API default (TRUE) left NULL. .return_raw Logical. TRUE, return full parsed CKAN response envelope instead processed result. Defaults FALSE.

title: Search a resource's rows — nhsbsa_datastore_search
text: Use function read rows — choosing ordering columns fields, sorting sort, paging limit/offset. filter value aggregate, use nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql() instead (see Details). CKAN datastore returns one page rows per request (server enforces maximum limit). rows exist returned, warning class nhsbsa_incomplete_results signalled describing page rest increasing offset. CKAN's datastore_search defines filters (exact field matching) q (full-text search) parameters, function exposes API completeness. portal's datastore apply — query using filters q returns matching rows — filter value, aggregate compute expressions, use nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql() SQL /GROUP clause. See vignette("nhsbsa") worked examples.

title: nhsbsa 0.1.0
text: Initial release: low-level client NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA) Open Data Portal, CKAN data catalogue. Dataset endpoints: nhsbsa_package_list(), nhsbsa_package_show() nhsbsa_package_search(). Resource endpoints file download: nhsbsa_resource_show(), nhsbsa_list_resources() nhsbsa_download_resource(). Datastore row queries: nhsbsa_datastore_search() nhsbsa_datastore_search_sql(). Catalogue listings: nhsbsa_organization_list(), nhsbsa_group_list() nhsbsa_tag_list(). nhsbsa_package_show(), nhsbsa_resource_show() nhsbsa_package_search() return classed lists tidy print() methods, tibble::as_tibble() methods turn dataset resources search one row per dataset.
